description:
You are an IT support specialist building a structured troubleshooting knowledge base for your team. Using TiddlyWiki at http://localhost:8080, create a set of 6 tiddlers that form a complete IT support knowledge base.

Create ALL of the following 6 tiddlers:

1. 'IT Support - Master Index': Hub tiddler listing all troubleshooting guides. Must contain a table with columns: Issue Category | Tiddler Link | Estimated Resolution Time | Difficulty. Include [[wikilinks]] to each of the other 5 tiddlers.

2. 'IT Support - Network Connectivity': Troubleshooting guide for network/internet issues. Structure with sections: !! Symptoms, !! Common Causes, !! Diagnostic Steps (numbered list), !! Solutions, !! When to Escalate. Include a table of diagnostic commands (Command | Platform | What It Shows).

3. 'IT Support - Slow Performance': Guide for diagnosing and fixing slow computer performance. Use the same section structure as above. Include a table of performance metrics to check (Metric | Normal Range | Concerning Threshold | Tool to Check).

4. 'IT Support - Printer Problems': Guide for printer connectivity and print quality issues. Include the structured sections and a table of common printer error codes (Error Code | Meaning | Fix).

5. 'IT Support - Email Configuration': Guide for email client setup and troubleshooting common email issues (IMAP/SMTP configuration, sync problems, authentication failures). Include a table of email protocol settings (Protocol | Port | Encryption | Use Case).

6. 'IT Support - Quick Reference Commands': Reference sheet with shell commands for common IT tasks. Must contain at least 3 tables organized by category:
   - File and disk operations (Command | Windows | Linux/Mac | Purpose)
   - Network diagnostics (Command | Windows | Linux/Mac | Purpose)
   - Process management (Command | Windows | Linux/Mac | Purpose)

All 6 tiddlers must:
- Be tagged with 'IT-Support'
- Use TiddlyWiki headings (!! for sections)
- Contain at least one wiki table (| pipe syntax)
- Include at least one [[wikilink]] to another tiddler in this set
- Contain at least 100 words each

No login is required. The wiki is available at http://localhost:8080.
